articles.title: Situation report on Bangladesh Flash Flood, July 2026
articles.description: Country: Bangladesh Source: Oxfam Please refer to the attached file. Since 4 July 2026, continuous heavy rainfall associated with an active monsoon and a persistent low-pressure system over the north-west Bay of Bengal, combined with upstream runoff, has triggered widespread flash floods, severe waterlogging, and landslides across southeastern, eastern, and northeastern Bangladesh. The disaster has affected more than 1.11 million people across 10 districts: Chattogram, Cox's Bazar, Sunamganj, Khagrachhari, Rangamati, Bandarban, Cumilla, Moulvibazar, Sylhet and Feni that resulting in 53 fatalities and 39 injuries as of today. While Chattogram District has experienced the highest level of impact in terms of the affected population. Exceptional rainfall has been recorded across the affected areas. Chattogram city received 412.3 mm of rainfall within 24 hours till date, marking the highest single-day July rainfall recorded in the past 42 years. The major rivers, including the Matamuhuri, Sangu, Surma, and Kushiyara, exceeded their danger levels, leading to embankment breaches, extensive flooding, and prolonged waterlogging. Several lowlying areas were completely inundated, including the entirety of Banshkhali Upazila in Chattogram District. In the hill districts of Chattogram Division, saturated slopes triggered multiple landslides, causing casualties, damaging homes and infrastructure, and disrupting road connectivity. Bangladesh’s flood threat is shifting from the country’s southeastern districts to the north and northeast, with forecasters warning that continued heavy rainfall and upstream runoff could trigger fresh flooding in Sylhet, Sunamganj and Rangpur over the coming days. The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has forecast moderate to very heavy rainfall across much of the country over the next several days, raising concerns that the existing flood situation could worsen before improving

articles.title: Horoscope for Wednesday, July 15, 2026
articles.description:
Moon Alert

Avoid shopping (except food and gas) and important decisions after 5 p.m. The moon is in Leo.

Aries (March 21-April 19)

A dynamic day

An unusual idea or an unexpected event might take you into an entirely new headspace today. You might entertain the notion of a new kind of future for yourself — something more romantic, more spiritual or touchy-feely (call it whatever you like) — than you had previously thought.

Taurus (April 20-May 20)

A positive day

You are certainly aware of the value of wealth in practical terms. However, today you might receive a new interpretation of the energy of wealth and what is possible to achieve — for yourself or for others. This is illuminating and perhaps liberating!

Gemini (May 21-June 20)

A positive day

Something might occur today that makes you more deeply appreciate a friend or a group to which you belong. You see that this interaction benefits you in an almost idealistic way. Or perhaps this person or group inspires you.

Cancer (June 21-July 22)

A positive day

Today you might be admired for taking a stand on a certain issue or speaking up about something that is important to you. What you do will reveal a level of compassion, understanding and idealistic values that might inspire someone else.

Leo (July 23-Aug. 22)

A dynamic day

Some kind of subtle shift might take place that prompts you to think about a different future for yourself. Or perhaps a different path? Or you might see how travel or further education can change your future? Whatever it is, it's heartening.

Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22)

A positive day

With Venus in your sign, you are gracious and diplomatic, which is a good thing because a boss, parent, or someone in authority might do something that catches you off guard. Ironically, whatever happens might open your eyes to a new way of doing things in the future.

Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22)

A positive day

People admire you right now. In an unexpected way, something related to travel, further education, medicine or the law might catch you off guard and open new worlds for you. This could be related to a friend or a group — or not. Be open to see what develops because it might be meaningful.

Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21)

A positive day

Be aware that people notice you today. Perhaps this is because something unexpected benefits you: an inheritance, a bonus, a gift, or the indirect benefit through a partner or friend. Whatever happens might allow you to expand your world in a way that offers you a more promising future.

Sagittarius (Nov. 22-Dec. 21)

A dynamic day

Listen to the ideas of partners, spouses and close friends because they might be the source of something that can lead to a positive shift in your life. It could be a deeper understanding or a deeper appreciation of what you have and who you are, or it might show you a door that you can open.

Capricorn (Dec. 22-Jan. 19)

A positive day

Something related to your health, your job, or even a pet might have the power to inspire you to consider something in a new light. You might not be content with old goals because, suddenly, new insights promise a refreshing level of consciousness.

Aquarius (Jan. 20-Feb. 18)

A positive day

You might feel more inspired by romance or something related to children that lifts you to a new level of appreciation and ambition. It's as if you are suddenly seeing new possibilities or appreciating things in a new way, and it's like an epiphany for you.

Pisces (Feb. 19-March 20)

A positive day

Your appreciation of the value of home and family might take on a new level of meaning today. You might suddenly grasp that it's something more important than you thought. Whatever happens opens your mind to a new awareness.

If today is your birthday

Actor Travis Fimmel (1979) shares your birthday today. You are imaginative, innovative and empathetic. You have astute analytical abilities. Exciting changes will bring increased personal freedom this year. Stay flexible. Let go of things that have held you back. Seek out new opportunities and be ready to act fast on them. Trust your intuition. Travel is likely.

articles.title: Plantwatch: Beware a tasty mushroom with a powerful hallucinogen
articles.description: Anyone eating Lanmaoa asiatica could have visions for days of tiny people running and jumping around Lanmaoa asiatica is a bolete mushroom, prized for its delicious taste and hugely popular in Yunnan province, China, where it is found growing in a symbiotic relationship with pine trees. But anyone eating the mushroom needs to be careful because it also gives hallucinations of lots of tiny people about 2cm tall wearing brightly coloured clothes, all jumping, running, climbing and being generally playful, but in a normal, real-world setting. The hallucinations are reminiscent of the small people in the hit BBC series Small Prophets , although without their psychic powers. Despite the powerful visions it brings, Lanmaoa is completely unrelated to Psilocybes, or “magic mushrooms”, which give wide-ranging hallucinations for a few hours triggered by the chemical psilocybin.
